name: @pipeworx/mcp-imgflip

tools.name: get_memes
tools.description: Browse the 100 most popular meme templates. Returns template name, image URL, dimensions, and text box coordinates. Use template IDs with caption_image to create memes.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-imgflip forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the imgflip pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
